name: s3CreateBucket
syntax: s3CreateBucket(bucket [, acl, location, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Creates a new S3 (or S3-compatible) bucket in the given location/region.

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket to create.

params.name: acl
params.description: Optional bucket ACL to apply (accepted for compatibility).

params.name: location
params.description: Bucket location/region constraint. Defaults to us-east-1.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Create a bucket
examples.description: Creates a bucket in the default region.
